method: Pending map rows whose original label is absent from same map file in local Japanese reference
limitations: New labels may be upstream version differences, not Wishes story.
Overwritten English dialogue under unchanged labels is NOT detected.
Folders absent from reference, non-map scripts/C text and unextracted strings are NOT covered.
Map-graph membership is an over-approximation and omits dynamic/C/common-script travel.
This only prioritizes candidates; zero candidates cannot prove story completion.
